title: Neon Don’ts
slide_intent: Identify misleading or cluttered effects so a network metaphor does not imply the wrong coverage or direction.
strategic_value: Restraint in neon application can keep T-Mobile’s network imagery plausible and readable.
demonstration: Four crossed examples show excessive house outlining, an arc, an unnatural monochrome transition and upward-directed beams.
practical_value: Remove excess highlights and avoid effects that look like rainbows, skyward transmission or poor coverage.

ingredient.name: Neon restraint
ingredient.role: Keep the network metaphor readable and tied to the scene.
ingredient.application: Avoid outlining every house, rainbow-like arcs, vertical/skyward beams, busy horizons and excessive monochrome coverage.
ingredient.scope: Environmental network imagery; these limits complement the approved neon behaviors.
